---
title: "Titan 历史快照：赔率与基本面试点"
params:
  fixture_ids: ["356275", "1784028"]
format: html
---

```{r}
source("r/quarto_helpers.R")
source("r/python_bridge.R")
project_root <- Sys.getenv("BEIJING_LOT_PROJECT_ROOT")
python <- Sys.getenv("BEIJING_LOT_VENV_PYTHON")
data_root <- beijing_data_root()
con <- connect_titan()
```

## 抓取进度

```{r}
DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM historical_fixture_capture) AS fixtures,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM historical_euro_1x2_quote) AS euro_quote_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM historical_aux_capture WHERE endpoint_kind = 'analysis') AS analysis_raw,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM historical_aux_capture WHERE endpoint_kind = 'handicap') AS handicap_raw,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM historical_fundamental WHERE fundamentals_available = 1) AS fundamentals
") |> tibble::as_tibble()
```

## 基本面样本

```{r}
fundamental <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    source_fixture_id, venue, weather, temperature, standings_link,
    home_form_json, away_form_json, h2h_json,
    home_season_stats_json, away_season_stats_json
  FROM historical_fundamental
  WHERE fundamentals_available = 1
  ORDER BY source_fixture_id
  LIMIT 1
") |> tibble::as_tibble()
fundamental %>% select(source_fixture_id, venue, weather, temperature, standings_link)
```

```{r}
if (nrow(fundamental) == 1) {
  cat("主队近况原始序列：\n", substr(fundamental$home_form_json[[1]], 1, 1000), "\n")
  cat("\n交锋原始序列：\n", substr(fundamental$h2h_json[[1]], 1, 1000), "\n")
  cat("\n主队赛季统计原始块：\n", fundamental$home_season_stats_json[[1]], "\n")
}
```

## 欧赔历史长表样本

```{r}
DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT
    q.batch_id, q.company_source_id, q.bookmaker_source_name,
    q.ordinal, q.home_odds, q.draw_odds, q.away_odds,
    q.market_time_source_raw, q.home_kelly, q.draw_kelly, q.away_kelly
  FROM historical_euro_1x2_quote q
  ORDER BY q.batch_id, q.company_source_id, q.ordinal
  LIMIT 30
") |> tibble::as_tibble()
```

## 使用提示

- `ordinal = 0` 为该公司在该场的第一条可见记录（initial 标记）；开赛前最大时间戳为 final 标记。
- 诊断切片：按 `market_time_source_raw` 做 as-of 取值；不证明赛前可用性。
- 倒计时节点：结合 fixture 的 `kickoff_source_raw`，取 initial / 10h / 1h / final。
- 亚盘 raw 已存于 `historical_aux_capture(endpoint_kind='handicap')`，解析表结构在确认试点后单独固化。

## 快照横截面派生（r/snapshots.R）

权威派生在 `src/titan_clean/snapshots.py`（时间解析、initial/final/10h/1h 语义、
source-binding receipt），R 经 reticulate 调用转 tibble 供检查。

```{r}
source("r/snapshots.R")
snap_long <- snapshot_long(
  data_root, project_root, python, fixture_ids = unlist(params$fixture_ids)
)
snap_long %>% filter(kind %in% c("initial", "final")) %>%
  select(fixture_id, kind, quote_key, home_odds, draw_odds, away_odds, market_time) %>%
  arrange(fixture_id, quote_key, kind)
```

2010 legacy 快照（356275）每公司有 initial（开盘）与 final（即时）两值共享同一更新时间；
现代快照（1784028）有完整四切片，final 严格取开赛前最后一条可见记录。

## 快照宽表

```{r}
snap_wide <- snapshot_wide(
  data_root, project_root, python, fixture_ids = unlist(params$fixture_ids)
)
snap_wide %>% select(any_of(c("quote_key", "home_odds_initial", "home_odds_10h",
  "home_odds_1h", "home_odds_final", "market_time_initial", "market_time_final")))
```
